title: Dart
content: **List of Contents** Dart Create Dart Create Dart with Specific Values **Dart** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wu-cknKD5zw \- Create Dart on Patterns. Because Patterns can be sewn without seam allowances in CLO, Dart will be sewn with the Pattern outlines. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021854067/mceclip0.png) **Dart** tool from the 2D toolbar or navigate to and select Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ **Dart.** ** Create Dart** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qTPxmGmM-7E \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021854067/mceclip0.png) **Dart** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Navigate to the 2D window and click and drag within a Pattern. \- The preview of the Dart will appear. \- Release the mouse to complete the Dart. **Create Dart with Specific Values** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5Zw15iDys3Q \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021854067/mceclip0.png) **Dart** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Navigate to the 2D window and click once within a Pattern. \- The Create Dart window will appear. \- Enter desired values to the Create Dart window and select OK. * **Size** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=silafU2IVJo \- Assign Width (Left), Width (Right), Height (Up), and Height (Down) which are measured from the center of the Dart. * **Position** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-l1vyDxjqks \- Assign the placement of the Dart. * **Outline** \- Enter Left, Right, Up, and Down values which indicate the margin between the Dart and the Pattern outline. * **Center** \- Enter Left, Right, Up, and Down values which are measured from the center of the Dart Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for creating and customizing darts in CLO 3D, featuring step-by-step instructions and helpful YouTube video tutorials.

title: [Popup] Copy/Paste Buttonhole
content: **List of Contents** Copy/Paste Buttonhole Input Interval/Number/Position to Copy/Paste Buttonhole ### ### **Objective** Copy and paste multiple buttonholes with keeping the interval space evenly. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button ** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005614447/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** **Operation** **Copy/Paste Buttonhole** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005614447/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** 2. Right click on an existing buttonhole, then select **Copy (Ctrl+C)** from the pop-up menu. 3. Right click again, then select **Paste (Ctrl+V)** from the pop-up menu. 4. Click on a desired place to locate the copy of the buttonhole. **Input Interval/Number/Position to Copy/Pase Buttonhole** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Select/Move Button** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005614447/____________.png) **Select/Move Button** 2. Right click on an existing buttonhole, then select **Copy (Ctrl+C)** from the pop-up menu. 3. Right click again, then select **Paste (Ctrl+V)** from the pop-up menu. 4. Right click on a desired place to locate the copy of the buttonhole. →The Paste window appears. 5. Input desired value for interval/number of buttonholes/position. **Interval** | Sets the distance between buttonholes. ---|--- **Number of Buttons/Buttonholes** | Sets the number of buttonholes to copy/paste. **Position** | Sets the position of the center of the copied button/buttonhole from the left/right/top/bottom of the pattern outline (ver2.5.0). 6. Click **OK**. → The buttonholes are now being created and applied accordingly. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions for efficiently copying and pasting multiple buttonholes while maintaining even spacing and precise positioning in your design.

Select a Topstitch with ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005619787/_________.png) **Edit Topstitch** tool in the 2D window for changing its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Curved ▶ **On** → The selected Topstitch is now being curved and smoothly extended. ![rightangledcorner.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115023689328/rightangledcorner.png) **Right Angled Corner** 1. Select a Topstitch with ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005619787/_________.png) **Edit Topstitch** tool in the 2D window for changing its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. title: 현재 사용중인 컴퓨터 사양을 알고 싶어요
content: ## Question * 현재 사용중인 컴퓨터 사양을 어떻게 확인할 수 있을까요? * 컴퓨터에 이상이 없는지 어떻게 확인하나요? * 내 그래픽 카드가 무엇인지 알고 싶어요. ## Answer * 일반적으로 잘 알려진 방법은 내 컴퓨터 > 우클릭 메뉴 > 속성을 선택하는 것입니다. * '**컴퓨터에 대한 기본 정보 보기** ' 화면에서는 CPU, 메모리, Windows 버전을 쉽게 확인할 수 있습니다. * 그래픽카드 정보, 자가 진단과 같은 자세한 정보는 아래에서 확인하세요. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360056607314) \-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ## Windows 사용자 * 내 컴퓨터 > 속성 * 시스템 정보 (msinfo32) * 바탕화면 우클릭 > Nvidia 제어판 > 속성 * DirectX 진단 도구 * 써드파티 프로그램 사용 ## Mac 사용자 * [이 Mac에 관하여](https://support.apple.com/ko-kr/HT201260) * About this Mac ## 같이 보기 * CLO 컴퓨터 권장사양 * 최적의 그래픽카드 선택 * 그래픽카드 드라이버 설치하기
content_description: 이 웹 페이지는 사용자가 자신의 컴퓨터 사양을 확인하고 이상 여부를 진단하며 그래픽 카드 정보를 찾는 방법을 안내합니다.

title: Edit Block Folders in the Modular Configurator Window
content: ### **Objective** Edit Block folders at your convenience to organize Blocks in the folders. ** Location** Vertical Menu Tab on the Left ▶ Modular Configurator ▶ (Select) **Block Folder** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Vertical Menu Tab on the Left ▶ Modular Configurator ▶ (Select) **Block Folder** → All Blocks in the selected Block folder appears in the Modular Configurator. 2. Select the ![edit_configurator.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026695168/edit_configurator.png) **Edit** button. → **Show** icons appear on every Garment thumbnails. 3. Select a Modular Structure file that you want to organize first. → All Blocks compatible with the selected Module Structure are now being displayed. 4. Click on the **Display** icon to either display or hide the Garments or Blocks → Hidden Garments or Blocks appear in lighter shade and the displayed Garments or Blocks appear in brighter shade. 5. Click on the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005619027/______.PNG) **Save** button to save in the configuration file in the same folder as the Block. 6. When editing is done, select the ![____3.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026695328/____3.png) **Exit** button. → The Blocks appear in the Modular Configurator accordingly. **※ Note: ** * It is able to tie the Modular configuration files as a group by adding a group in the Editor Mode when needing a category that is above all the Modular configuration files. * Unlikely to the Blocks, one Modular configuration file can only be included in one group.

title: [Property] 3D Seamline
content: ### **Objective** Adjust **Intensity** and **Thickness** of 3D seamlines to render a realistic Garment. ** Location ** Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ **Edit Sewing ** 3D/2D Toolbar ▶ ![edit_sewing.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024256947/edit_sewing.png) **Edit Sewing** ** Operation ** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. 2. Select a Sewing Line. → Properties of the Sewing Line appears in the Property Editor. 3. Adjust the settings below as needed: **Option** | **Description** ---|--- [**Normal Map**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000447607) **(ver 5.2)** | Select an image to be used as the Normal Map. **Intensity (%)** | Adjust the intensity of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. **Thickness** | Adjust the thickness of the Normal Map applied to the seamline.
content_description: This web page provides users with step-by-step instructions to adjust the intensity and thickness of 3D seamlines for realistic garment rendering in the Clo3D software.

title: Layer
content: **List of Contents** Layer Set Layer **Layer** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jSKSGF9r-dI \- Set the order of Layers to easily simulate layered 3D Garments. \- Navigate to the Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ **Layer.** ** ****Set Layer** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0iDh933y9M0 \- Using the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022754007/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool, select the Pattern to be edited. \- Navigate to the Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ **Layer.** \- Type in the value for the Layer option. Assign the greater value to the Patterns layered outwards. \- When the Layer value is assigned, the selected Patterns will be highlighted in neon green. \- Simulate to apply the setting. When Garments are completely simulated, reflecting the Layer setting, turn off the Simulation and reset Layer values of all Patterns to 0. \- When Layer values is 0, Patterns are simulated according to the order placed in the 3D window. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on managing layer settings for simulating layered 3D garments, complete with instructional videos and step-by-step procedures.

title: Custom Resolution
content: **List of Contents** Custom Resolution Save/Open Custom Resolution **Custom Resolution** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-0sedG4a_6s \- Save and open customized resolution of the 3D Garment as needed. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021911628/mceclip0.png) **Custom Resolution** tool from the 3D toolbar. **Save/Open Custom Resolution** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NPR-XQTB1bo \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021911628/mceclip0.png) **Custom Resolution** tool from the 3D toolbar. \- The**Custom Resolution** widget will appear on the right top corner of the 3D window. * **Save Custom Resolution** \- Click on the **Add** icon on the right top corner of the Custom Resolution widget. 。 \- Current resolution will be saved and listed in the Custom Resolution widget. \- The resolution includes Particle Distance, Add’ll Thickness - Collision/Rendering, Avatar Skin Offset, and Simulation Preset. * **Open Custom Resolution** \- Double click the saved custom resolution to return to its resolution setting while working on the 3D Garment. \- The custom resolution will be reflected on the 3D Garment. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on how to save and open custom resolutions for 3D garments using the Custom Resolution tool in Clo3D.

title: Delete Curve Point
content: **Objective** Delete unnecessary curve points when editing Patterns. When all curve points on a segment is deleted, it turns to a straight line. ** Location** **Delete Selected** Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ **Edit Curve Point** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001140388/________.png) **Edit Curve Point** **Delete All ** Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) ▶ **Delete All Curve Points** ** Operation** **Delete Selected** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ **Edit Curve Point** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001140388/________.png) **Edit Curve Point** 2. Right click on the curve point to be deleted and select **Delete** on the pop-up menu. Or, select the curve point and hit Delete key on the keyboard. **※ Note:** * Multiple curve points cannot be moved at once for now due to technical limitation. * When you delete a segment point added on a curved line, all curved points on that specific line are deleted and so as the curvature. **Delete All** 1. Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the ![2.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115001093267/2.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. Then, select a segment which all curved points should be deleted. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) ▶ **Delete All Curve Points** → All curve points on the selected segment are deleted.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for deleting unnecessary curve points in 2D Pattern editing, transforming segments into straight lines when all curve points are removed.

title: Unfold
content: ### **Objective** Unfold a half pattern as a full pattern with no center line or seam. ### **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CwB8_ad328M?si=NtcMsisnB9xq_Ge_ &start=1988** ### ** ****Location** ### Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ **Edit Pattern** ### 2D Toolbar ▶ **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001059728/2.png)****Edit Pattern** ### **Operation** 1. Click the tool/menu indicated. 2. Right-click on the fiducial segment of the pattern, and click **Unfold** menu. → The selected pattern and internal polygon are unfolded symmetrically. 3. Or if you only want to unfold the pattern except for the internal lines or base lines, click **Unfold Pattern Outline Only** menu. → Only the pattern unfolds, with the internal polygons and baselines located on one side. (ver 7.2) **※Note:** You can unfold multiple patterns at once by selecting the center lines of the patterns at the same time. (ver 7.2)
content_description: Discover how to seamlessly unfold a half pattern into a full pattern without center lines or seams using our easy-to-follow guide and tutorial video.

title: Subsurface Scattering Material
content: **Objective** Realistically express human skin. Subsurface Scattering Material penetrates and scatters under the objects' surface. Utilize the material to illustrate leaves, fruit, candles and more. Application results are only be viewed in the [Render ](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014784747-Run-V-Ray-Render)window. [Watch Tutorial Video](https://youtu.be/myqp2Li8FiI) **Location** Fabric Property Editor ▶ Material ▶ Type ▶ **Skin (Render Only)** ** Operation** 1. Select the menu/tool indicated.** ****** 2. Refer to the table below to edit the properties. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- **Mix** | Adjust the value of Subsurface Scattering (in which light is scattered by penetrating objects). If the value is 0, the material is not applied and is reflected only on the surface of the object. If the value is 1, it is applied to the maximum extent and does not reflect on the surface of the object. **Mix Map**(ver 7.1) | Apply a Mix Map to partially apply the amount of subsurface scattering. **Density Scale** | Adjust the size property of an object to adjust the extent to which SSS is applied. The smaller the value, the wider the SSS coverage. **※ Note:** The Density Scale is applied by multiplying/sharing of each layer radius value, so adjust only the size to which SSS is applied while maintaining the radius ratio between the three layers. **Shallow / Medium / Deep ** | Adjust the properties of the three layers of subsurface scattering to express composite materials. Color | Set the color of the light to be scattered. Color Map | Use a map to express the desired color in the desired area. Weight | The weight of the layer sets the intensity of the color and map of the layer that is set against the other layer. If the value is 1, it has the highest weight. Radius | Set the radius in which each layer scatters inside the surface of the object. 3. Start the [Render](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115014784747-V-Ray-%EB%A0%8C%EB%8D%94-%EC%8B%A4%ED%96%89) window. → Subsurface Scattering Material materials are applied. **※ Note:** When two or more meshes are overlapped, SSS materials can appear abnormally. Therefore, take the overlapped meshes off each other using other 3D programs, or import the meshes separately and apply SSS materials. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360097836353/mceclip0.png)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on using Subsurface Scattering Material to realistically render human skin and other organic materials in 3D modeling.

title: How to Fix the Error using Intel Graphics Card
content: **List of Contents** Case 1 Case 2 (If the error is not resolved by Case 1) Objective Learn how to resolve launching error using Intel HD Graphics. Operation Since this crashing is due to a Graphic driver which is automatically updated by Microsoft Windows, please re-install the Intel graphics driver after deactivating "Windows Automatic Updates". Case 1 1. Please input "gpedit.msc" on Search tool and execute it. 2. Local Group Policy Editor ▶ Computer Configuration ▶ Administrative Templates ▶ Windows Components ▶ Windows Updates ▶ activate "Do not include drivers with Windows Update" ![image_1_1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003369948/image_1_1.png)**※ Note:** The option may not appear in the Window versions below. In this case, External Graphics card should be used. (Please refer to [Computer Specification](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000307168-Computer-Specifications)) Windows 7 Home Edition / Windows 10 Home Edition 3. Device Manager ▶ Display Adapters ▶ Intel(R) HD Graphic ▶ Uninstall the device and driver software ▶ Reboot Windows ![image_2_1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003447047/image_2_1.png) 4. Enter [Intel Support Page](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/intel-driver-support-assistant.html) and download and install the program of Intel® Driver & Support Assistant. 5. Start scanning the driver. 6. Download and Reinstall the driver of Intel(R) HD Graphics. 7. Verify the "23.20.16.4901" version is installed correctly.![image_3.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003369968/image_3.png) 8. Please reboot Windows. 9. If the Error is not resolved with Case 1, please proceed Case 2 below. **Case 2** If the Error is not resolved with Case 1, please proceed Case 2. 1. Please enter [Intel® Graphics Driver for Windows*](https://downloadcenter.intel.com/download/27412/Graphics-Intel-Graphics-Driver-for-Windows-15-60-?wapkw=hd+graphic) and Download & Install the driver. 2. Approve overwrite to the previous version during Installation. ![image_3_1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360003369988/image_3_1.png) Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide to resolve launching errors related to Intel HD Graphics by reinstalling the appropriate drivers.

title: Polygon
content: **List of Contents** Polygon Create Polygon Create Polygon with Curves Create Polygon with Specific Values Create Points in Guidelines Cancel the Last Action Cancel All Actions **Polygon** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Uti_3pcl_Tc \- Create Polygon Patterns in the 2D window. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022648248/mceclip0.png) **Polygon** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Or, navigate to the Main Menu and select 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ **Polygon.** ** Create Polygon** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j6Pi66_PVQQ \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022648248/mceclip0.png) **Polygon** tool and click on the 2D window to draw desired shape of Polygon. \- Click the start point again to complete the Pattern. **Create Polygon with Curves** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7pzr1ZXjZ5Q \- Hold down the Ctrl key while clicking the 2D window to create curves with the free curve point. \- Or, click and drag the mouse while adding a point on the 2D window to create curves with AI Bezier handles. **Create Polygon with Specific Values** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bhp9XaIe_34 \- Click and then right click on the 2D window to access the Create Polygon window. \- Type in the desired value to Length. **Create Points in Guidelines** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1qiaU65EdiU \- Hold down the Shift key on the keyboard to add points in a straight line or a diagonal line. **Cancel the Last Action** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AYTWW0AnB34 \- While creating the Polygon Pattern, hit the Delete key on the keyboard to cancel the last action. **Cancel All Actions** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EZYAyQAbwcc \- While creating the Polygon Pattern, hit the Esc or Ctrl+Z keys on the keyboard to cancel all actions. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage serves as a comprehensive guide for creating and managing polygon patterns in a 2D design environment, featuring instructional videos and step-by-step procedures.

title: Library Window
content: **Objective** Conveniently manage and open files in the program using the Library Window. Add frequently used folders to the Library to easily open files: drag and drop a file from the registered folder into the 3D Window or with the left mouse button, double click the file. ![CLO_Guide_EN_05_Library.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360042497574) ** Operation** **![Download.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360043341233)Download** | Download newly added default files as a whole. Selectively download files from the folder with the "N" sign. ---|--- **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005506088/___.png)Reset** | Reset registered folders in the Library. **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005506068/____.png)Add Folder** | Add frequently used folders to the Library. View the hierarchy of subfolders in the added folder as tree view. **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005506048/____.png)Refresh** | Apply any changes made in the Library such as deleting or adding folders. **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005506028/___.png)List /![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005506108/___.png) Icon** | Toggle between different views. **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005506008/rjator.png)Search** | Use Search to locate files quickly and efficiently within the Library. ** ※ Note:** * Hover over the desired Project/Garment file thumbnail to preview font, back, and side views. * To change the thumbnail image of a folder in the Library window, please open the corresponding folder installed on your computer. Place the desired image to the folder and rename the image according to below pattern Pattern: CLOicon_FolderName E.g.: CLOicon_Avatar
content_description: Effortlessly organize and access your files using the Library Window, enabling quick management through features like folder addition, file downloads, and efficient searching.

title: Express Double Sided
content: ### **Objective** Without putting two Patterns together, it is able to express double sided effect. **Location** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005494667/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) **Edit Pattern** / ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005494687/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png) **Transform Pattern** **Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005494667/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) **Edit Pattern** / ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005494687/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png) **Transform Pattern ** 2. Select a Pattern or Pattern line to express doubled sided effect. → Its properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on how to express a double-sided effect in patterns using the 2D Toolbar in CLO 3D.

title: Curved Side Geometry
content: ### **Objective** Apply and adjust curvature on edges of Patterns for more natural and realistic look (ver2.2.0). **Location** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005541708/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png) **Transform Pattern** / ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005494467/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) **Edit Pattern** **Operation** 1. Firstly, change the 3D Garment rendering style to **Thick Textured Surface** in the 3D window. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar **▶![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005541708/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Transform.png) Transform Pattern** **/![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005494467/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) Edit Pattern**** ** 3. Select a Pattern or Pattern line to express curved sided effect. → Its properties appear in the Property Editor. 4. Enter a desired value at: Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Curved Side Geometry ▶ **Curvature (%) ** → The curvature is now being applied according to the entered value. **※ Note:** The maximum **Curvature (%)** value is 50 percent (%) of the fabric thickness. For instance, if the fabric thickness is being set at 1mm, the maximum **Curvature (%)** is 0.5mm.
content_description: Discover how to enhance the realism of your garment designs by applying and adjusting curvature on pattern edges using the 2D Toolbar in version 2.2.0.
